shortDescription: Manage utility licenses on a BIG-IQ

options.name: accept_eula
options.description: A key that signifies you accept the F5 EULA for this license. A copy of the EULA can be found here https://askf5.f5.com/csp/article/K12902 This is required when C(state) is C(present).

options.name: license_key
options.description: The license key to install and activate.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the utility license on the system. When C(present), guarantees the license exists. When C(absent), removes the license from the system.
